_comment: Threshold requirements, North Carolina 2026, Section IV only. Section VI (general threshold requirements pp.29-31 and underwriting threshold requirements pp.31-34) is NOT extracted here and remains outstanding. Page numbers are PDF page indices.

criteria.heading: General site requirements
criteria.quote: Sites must be sized to accommodate the number and type of units proposed
criteria.note: Site control by the preliminary application deadline with a plot plan; zoning and any discretionary land use approval in place by the full application deadline; water and sewer with adequate capacity; the Agency's Notice of Real Property Acquisition form executed by all parties at or before the option or contract.

criteria.heading: Minimum site score of 50
criteria.quote: An application must have a minimum total score of 50 points
criteria.note: Each site scoring factor is also a threshold in its own right: the Agency may remove an application whose site is sufficiently inadequate in any one category.

criteria.heading: Market analysis
criteria.quote: The Agency will administer the market study process based on this Section
criteria.note: The Agency contracts the analysts directly and is not bound by their conclusions. One round of applicant revisions only. Preferences by jurisdiction of residence, particular disability or occupational group are prohibited; age-restricted projects may not have three-bedroom units; no more than four income bands.

criteria.heading: Federal rental assistance conversion
criteria.quote: Applicants proposing to convert tenant-based Housing Choice Vouchers
criteria.note: Requires a letter from the issuing authority in an Agency-approved form; treated like a funding source, and failing the Agency's requirements makes the project ineligible for an allocation.

criteria.heading: Income averaging conditions
criteria.quote: Only new construction projects and rehabilitation projects not subject to an existing Declaration
criteria.note: Average at or below 60% AMI for the property and for each bedroom type, at least 10% of low-income units at or below 30% AMI, no market-rate units, and the multiple building election on Form 8609.

criteria.heading: Total replacement cost cap
criteria.quote: Total Replacement Costs must not exceed $350,000 per unit
criteria.note: Separate from the per-unit development cost limits that carry negative points.

criteria.heading: Development experience
criteria.quote: North Carolina or six (6) separate 9% Tax Credit projects totaling in excess of 200 units
criteria.note: The experienced principal must be named as the applicant, become a general partner or managing member, and stay responsible for at least two years after placed in service. Projects counted must have been placed in service between 1 January 2017 and 1 January 2025.

criteria.heading: Management experience
criteria.quote: The management agent must be eligible to be on the Approved Management Company List
criteria.note: Requires a similar tax credit project in the current portfolio, registration with the Secretary of State, timely compliance reporting, and supervisory staff who have attended at least three Agency trainings in the past 12 months.

criteria.heading: Project team disqualifications
criteria.quote: The Agency may disqualify any owner, Principal or management agent, who
criteria.note: Eleven grounds, including debarment, bankruptcy or adverse fair housing or civil rights determinations in the past ten years, mortgage default within five years, uncorrected noncompliance, outstanding HUD 2530 flags, unapproved general partner changes, and having requested a qualified contract in North Carolina. Disqualification removes every application the party appears in.

criteria.heading: Project size limits
criteria.quote: New construction 9% Tax Credit projects may not exceed the following
criteria.note: 120 units in the Metro Region, 84 in Central, East and West; tax-exempt bond new construction is capped at 200 unless approved beforehand. The Agency may waive these for proposals that reduce low-income and minority concentration, for transit station areas, or where a building's structure requires it.

criteria.heading: Minimum project size
criteria.quote: All new construction projects must have at least twenty-four (24) qualified low-income units

criteria.heading: ENERGY STAR certification
criteria.quote: New construction residential buildings must achieve ENERGY STAR Multifamily New
criteria.note: Adaptive re-use and rehabilitation comply to the extent economically feasible and as historic preservation rules allow.

criteria.heading: Targeting programme
criteria.quote: All projects will be required to target ten percent (10%) of the total units to persons with disabilities
criteria.note: Projects with federal project-based rental assistance target at least five units regardless of size. Targeted units do not require onsite supportive services or a service coordinator. Seven documents are due no later than six months before placed in service.

criteria.heading: Design threshold requirements
criteria.quote: The minimum threshold requirements for design are found in Appendix B
criteria.note: Appendix B is incorporated by reference and applies to every project receiving tax credits or RPP funding. It is a separate document and is not in the corpus.

criteria.heading: Rehabilitation set-aside eligibility
criteria.native_category: Criteria for Selection of Rehabilitation Projects
criteria.quote: not have an acquisition cost in excess of sixty percent
criteria.note: Nine conditions, including placed in service on or before 31 December 2010, rehabilitation expenses above $50,000 per unit, not feasible with tax-exempt bonds, no Agency loan in the last five years, not requiring demolition, no Mark to Market restructuring in five years, and total replacement costs under $190,000 per unit.
